Subject: OneTrust account onboarding — service account for SSO + rotation cadence

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for running the portal onboarding for NimblePay. We're working through OneTrust's checklist and they requested a dedicated service account (read-only) for our SSO integration and a documented rotation cadence for any long-lived credentials tied to the portal (service keys, API tokens).

Can Redwood confirm:
- Whether you prefer a dedicated service account per customer or a multi-tenant service account with scoped tokens
- The default rotation cadence Redwood recommends for portal API keys (we want to ensure this aligns with our internal policy)
- Any evidence we should upload to OneTrust to show possession and rotation governance (audit logs, KMS key references, rotation playbook)

I've attached the OneTrust onboarding checklist they gave us, and a short list of questions the infosec team has. We are aiming to complete onboarding by next Friday (2027-07-02).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Lisa

Attachments: onetrust-checklist.pdf (included by NimblePay)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust account onboarding — service account for SSO + rotation cadence

Hi Lisa — thanks for the checklist and the timeline. High-level answers and proposed next steps below. I've attached a rotation-schedule-template you can fill and upload to OneTrust as the "evidence of rotation policy."

Quick answers:
- Preferred pattern: Dedicated customer-scoped service account per customer (recommended). This reduces blast radius and makes audit/possession evidence straightforward.
- Rotation cadence: Default is 90 days for API tokens tied to the portal, with emergency rotation within 24 hours for suspected compromise. For KMS-protected keys we support automatic rotation but will accept 180-day cadence if you need less operational churn.
- Evidence to upload to OneTrust: rotation schedule CSV (attached), signed possession statement (we can provide a template), KMS key id + last-rotation timestamp, and a short playbook describing rotation steps and verification. We can also share a hashed log sample for proof possession if required.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Lisa: confirm you want a dedicated NimblePay service account (we'll create one scoped to the OneTrust connector).
2) Lisa: fill the attached rotation-schedule-template.csv with target dates and retention windows.
3) Redwood (Karthik): create the service account, enable least-privilege roles, and provide the API token to your SRE as an ephemeral secret via our transfer method (we'll avoid plaintext email).
4) Redwood: upload the initial evidence bundle and share the OneTrust portal link so NimblePay can confirm.

I copied Karthik (platform security) to outline technical steps; Ben (your AE) is on the thread for timing/contract alignment. If you want, we can do a 20-minute quick call today to confirm the rotation cadence.

Monica
Monica Patel
Vendor Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0198

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lisa Park <security@nimblepay.com>, OneTrust Onboarding <onetrust-setup@onetrust.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust account onboarding — service account for SSO + rotation cadence

Agree with Monica — we'll provision a dedicated NimblePay service account in our portal with least privilege (read-only to the connector resources). Operational notes and what I'll do once we get confirmation: 

- Create service account: nimblepay-ot-service@redwood-inference (tenant-scoped).
- Credentials: short-lived JWT bound to the account via our internal token broker (default TTL 12 hours). We'll also create a long-lived API token for onboarding only, stored in our HSM-backed vault and rotated to a 90-day schedule.
- Evidence artifacts we'll provide: KMS key ARN, last_rotation_iso timestamp, rotation-schedule CSV filled by NimblePay, and audit log snippet showing the create/rotate events.

If NimblePay prefers the long-lived token to be rotated by their SRE team, we can provide the key metadata and a signing URL for in-place rotation. For OneTrust uploads we usually: upload a signed possession PDF, the CSV schedule, and a link to our audit log sample (we can redact specific identifiers).

Command sample we will run internally to create the service account (for transparency):
- redwoodctl iam service-accounts create --name nimblepay-ot-service --roles connector.readonly --tenant nimblepay

I'll coordinate with Onetrust onboarding to ensure the account is visible in their connector list. Monica — please sign off and I'll create the account and share a secure transfer link for the initial token.

Karthik Iyer
Platform Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Monica / Karthik — thanks, this all looks good. We confirm: dedicated NimblePay service account and 90-day rotation cadence is acceptable.

I've filled the rotation-schedule-template.csv (attached) and signed the possession statement in DocuSign; the signed PDF is attached (nimblepay-acceptance-docusign.pdf) and the envelope id is 0a1b2c (link in related_links). Please proceed with provisioning and upload the evidence bundle to the OneTrust connector when the account exists. Our target for complete onboarding remains EOD 2027-07-02.

On a separate note, our audit team asked that Redwood include an automated webhook call to notify us when a rotation event occurs so we can tie it to our internal ticketing. Is that something you can support via the connector? If not, we can poll the audit logs (we prefer webhook).

Thanks — Lisa
